name: What is the typical lifespan of high-quality countertops installed by AKN Design Group?

mainEntity.name: What is the typical lifespan of high-quality countertops installed by AKN Design Group?

acceptedAnswer.text: High-quality countertops, such as natural stone or engineered quartz installed by AKN Design Group, are designed to last for decades, often exceeding 20-30 years with proper care and maintenance. The exact lifespan can vary based on the material chosen, daily usage, and adherence to manufacturer guidelines for cleaning and sealing (for natural stone). Our commitment to craftsmanship ensures that the installation itself is robust and supports the longevity of the material, contributing to the lasting impressions of your home. This focus on durability enhances functionality, beauty, and long-term value, aligning with our specialization in high-value renovations.
acceptedAnswer.description: High-quality countertops installed by AKN Design Group typically last 20-30+ years with proper care, varying by material and usage, ensuring long-term value.
